profile.reading: This building near Souder Road outside New Albany, in Plain Township, Franklin County, Ohio, is tagged with the name Compugen New Albany. A second, nearby point roughly half a mile away carries the identical name, which more likely reflects a single site entered twice in mapping data than two genuinely distinct facilities. Compugen Inc. is a real, Canada based information technology services company, one of Canada's largest privately owned IT providers, offering hardware, cloud, security, and managed services to business, education, and healthcare customers. Checking Compugen's own published list of office locations across North America turns up addresses in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, and Saskatchewan in Canada, plus a single United States office in Houston, Texas. No Ohio or Columbus area office appears on that list. New Albany, Ohio has become a major hub for large hyperscale data centers built by several technology companies over the past decade, which may explain how a building in the area came to be tagged as a data center in mapping data, but nothing found connects the well known Compugen IT services company to a facility here. This entry is filed as an unconfirmed match. The Compugen name attached to this building could not be tied to Compugen Inc.'s known United States operations, and no capacity or specification figures are published for it.

profile.research_note: Compugen Inc.'s own contact/locations page (fetched directly) lists only Canadian offices plus a single US office in Houston, TX -- no Ohio presence. This is fairly strong evidence against a genuine Compugen facility in New Albany, OH. Kept as unconfirmed match rather than asserting mistag outright, since a different/unrelated local business named Compugen cannot be ruled out.
